question: [FREE] Based on the video clip, what probe-placement strategy is used to improve the obstructed view, and why does it help?

model_prediction:
The strategy used is intercostal probe placement with sweeping/angulation of the probe through the intercostal space, to avoid the acoustic shadow cast by ribs.

Ribs are highly attenuating to ultrasound, so they completely block sound waves and produce a dark shadow that obscures the view of deeper structures. Positioning the probe so the ultrasound beam passes through the soft tissue between ribs, rather than through a rib itself, eliminates this shadow, allowing visualization of underlying anatomy.
